definitions.title: Volume by Slicing Formula
definitions.latex: V = \int_a^b A(x) dx, \quad \text{where } A(x) \text{ is cross-sectional area}
definitions.statement: The volume of a solid of integrable cross-sectional area A(x) from x = a to x = b is the integral of A(x) with respect to x.
conditions: A(x) is continuous or piecewise continuous on [a, b]
definitions.explanation: Slicing slices the 3D solid into thin slabs of thickness dx and base area A(x).
definitions.keyTakeaway: Volume equals the integral of cross-sectional area along the perpendicular axis.

definitions.title: The Disk and Washer Methods
definitions.statement: When a planar region is revolved about an axis, the cross-sections perpendicular to the axis of revolution are disks (solid) or washers (with circular holes). R(x) is the outer radius and r(x) is the inner radius.
conditions: Rotation axis is perpendicular to cross-sections
definitions.explanation: Disk method applies when the region touches the axis of rotation; washer method applies when there is a gap.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Integrate pi times the difference of squared radii.
